summary: Star Equity Holdings filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) to register an at-the-market offering of up to $8,700,000 of its 10% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (STOCK SYMBOL: STRRP). The company engages Ladenburg Thalmann as sales agent under an at-market issuance sales agreement, with a 3.0% commission. The filing is a routine shelf takedown for capital-raising, not triggered by an extraordinary event such as an acquisition, tender, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation. No change of control, board recommendation, advisor, or structural anomaly is present. This is an ordinary equity-linked financing.
